Stalin Criticizes Price Rise, Urges CM to Visit Local Shops

Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M.K. Stalin has criticized the ruling party over rising prices, stating that people are gripped by fear of inflation rather than being in a festive mood. He urged Chief Minister Vijay to visit local grocery shops to understand the extent of the price increase, asserting that the public fears inflation despite official claims to the contrary. Separately, a figure named Tagore questioned the DMK regarding their ties with the BJP.
